policies.text: A hardware model meets standards for premium healthcare devices if it possesses ISO 13485 certification and maintains designation of extended durability.
A product is assigned eligibility for priority distribution provided it satisfies standards for premium healthcare devices.
A commercial generator receives eco-label certification when its performance index reaches at least 95 percent.
A unit attains high-efficiency solar status if peak output is no less than 450 W.
A cooling system qualifies for ultra-quiet equipment status when operational noise does not exceed 32 dB.
Authorization for clinical deployment on a fast-track basis requires eligibility for priority distribution.
A device qualifies for designation of extended durability when its uninterrupted operational duration reaches a minimum threshold of 500 hours.
A fluid pump obtains marine grade authorization when its submersion depth limit reaches 50 meters.
